title: Helping a Stranger Without Expecting Thanks
paragraphs: Driving home late one night, Yumna noticed a stranded motorist struggling with a flat tire on a quiet, poorly lit stretch of road that most drivers were passing without stopping.
Despite feeling slightly nervous about stopping for someone she did not know, she pulled over, helped him change the tire using tools from her own car, and left before he could properly thank her.
A week later, a local news article mentioned an anonymous woman who had helped someone that same night, and Yumna quietly recognized the story without ever mentioning her involvement to anyone.
She later told a close friend that she preferred the help remain anonymous, believing that a good deed done for recognition loses something genuine that only quiet sincerity can preserve.
